sentence_stem: The bus is late again, so
correct_completion: I will walk to school today.
full_sentence: The bus is late again, so I will walk to school today.
acceptable_variants: I will take my bike instead.
I will ask my dad for a ride.

options.why_wrong: This describes the bus, but it does not give a result of the bus being late.

options.text: I will walk to school today.
but I am still at home.
options.why_wrong: 'But' signals a contrast, while 'so' needs a result. This does not follow from the bus being late.
'Because' introduces a cause, but the stem already needs a result after 'so'.

explanation: After 'so', the sentence must give the result of the first clause. Here the late bus leads to a decision to walk instead.
translation: Автобус знову спізнюється, тому я піду до школи сьогодні.
